transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got the urgent bracket order to review today. As I understand it, refurbished stamping die D-18 is available and Press 2 is currently the planned machine. Before I make the production authorization call, I need to go through our standard pre-run gate. Maintenance and quality engineering — please state any unresolved technical or release conditions so I can make the go/no-go decision. I also want to confirm: does anyone have input on whether we should consider Press 5 instead, given it's idle through the end of the week?
